paragraphs.text: Powerstone is an artifact type and predefined token introduced in Dominaria United .

Each Powerstone token has the artifact subtype “Powerstone” and the ability “ : Add . This mana can't be spent to cast a nonartifact spell.” All generators of this token create them tapped. While the first reading suggests the mana is useful only for artifact spells, it can also pay for activated abilities, payments of triggered abilities, ward costs, and taxes. Much like treasure , they add a boost to tempo in a specific way and are prime to sacrifice once mana is in excess.

Powerstones were previewed with Karn, Living Legacy and The Mana Rig in Dominaria United , and became a main mechanic in The Brothers' War . Given the poor reception of that set, Mark Rosewater is skeptical that powerstones will return any time soon. That said, Vibranium token from Marvel Super Heroes has the same ability. From the same set, Hydraulic Helper generates mana with the same clause.
